summary.name: KDnuggets
summary.one_liner: KDnuggets is a data science, machine learning, and AI publication that posts tutorials, roadmaps, and articles on Python and analytics topics.
use_cases: learn data science and machine learning for free
follow python tutorials for building ai apps
find career roadmaps for ai and data roles
keep up with ai model and tool news
read guides on working with llm APIs
summary.what_it_does: KDnuggets is a website focused on data science, machine learning, AI, and analytics. The page lists recent articles such as tutorials on calling multiple AI models through the OpenRouter API, building a Python AI agent with the OpenAI Agents SDK, and python design patterns for data scientists. It also has career roadmaps, for example for computer vision engineers and AI product managers. The page lists no tool or software product; it is an editorial content site.
notable: Long-running publication with tutorials, roadmaps, and industry articles on data science and AI
Recent posts cover practical LLM topics such as OpenRouter, local models, and the OpenAI Agents SDK
Listed as a free educational website in the eudk/awesome-ai-tools collection
caveats: Content is articles, not a software tool; no downloadable product is described on the page
Pricing is not stated on the page; listed as a free educational resource by the source list
